cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.

mechanism: A copies financial-event jargon without understanding it to sell escalating self-funded auction costs as responsible protection.
confusable: S04 must learn wrong meaning from a model; D17 must visibly rationalize a damaging plan.
comparison: Financial commitment versus a physical renovation.
seedUse: D17-b absence of bidders becomes reason to spend more, not an unrelated new obstacle.
